title: Investigating Interfacial Behaviors in Lithium Metal Batteries Using Multi-Modal and Multi-Dimensional Cryogenic Electron Tomography
content: Lithium metal batteries are considered one of the most promising systems for high-energy storage, yet they remain far from widespread application. A key challenge is understanding the interfacial properties of solid electrolyte interfaces (SEIs) within these batteries. The complexity, dynamics, and vulnerability of SEIs have long posed significant hurdles for both the electron microscopy and battery communities. A major gap remains in developing tools that provide comprehensive insights into the morphology, structure, and chemical composition of SEIs under native conditions.
